description: Update the remote patterns matching logic to ensure that the /* glob pattern behaves consistently with /** and doesn't match unintended paths. This fix will prevent edge cases where certain URL paths could be incorrectly allowed or blocked by remote pattern configurations.
functional_requirements: Fix the /* glob pattern implementation to match only immediate children (single path segment) rather than potentially matching deeper paths
Ensure the /* pattern behavior aligns with the /** pattern's intended scope and doesn't create security or validation gaps
Maintain backward compatibility for all existing valid remote pattern configurations while fixing the edge case behavior
Add comprehensive test coverage to verify the corrected glob matching behavior for various URL path scenarios
